One manual session: up to 60 HTTP GETs and 4 MiB downloaded, a roughly 3-minute time stop checked between files. Completed results stay in Room. You can stop and resume; there is no automatic whole-folder scan. Mobile data charges may apply.

Proven bounded mode: up to 4 batches (240 GET / 16 MiB), four concurrent files. Continues while the app is backgrounded or the screen is locked. Every file is checkpointed in Room; no Wi-Fi restriction.

One explicit start automatically chains capped batches. Up to 80 batches / 4,800 GET / 320 MiB / four hours; resume safely from Room if the limit is reached. Bounded pauses and retries on transient server errors; authentication failure stops the run. Works in background; does not auto-start after device reboot. Other audio formats are not yet supported by the fast tag parser.
